meta.name: Vanish AI Android Design System
meta.purpose: A comprehensive, AI-readable guide to build new features in the Android app with consistent styling. This document reflects the ACTUAL Compose components, colors, typography, and patterns in the codebase.

nonNegotiables: Use Jetpack Compose for all UI. No XML layouts for UI components.
All components must use Material 3 theme system via VanishAITheme.
Aurora Glass aesthetic: translucent surfaces with backdrop blur, thin white borders, restrained glow effects.
Prefer spacing over dividers. Dividers only for tables/lists.
Every interactive element must have visible hover/pressed/focused/disabled states.
Use Helvetica font family for all text (loaded from res/font/).
Edge-to-edge display enabled. System bars are transparent.
informationHierarchy: 1) Scale/size establishes hierarchy (display styles for hero headlines, headline styles for section titles).
2) Opacity/alpha establishes secondary levels (TextTertiary52 for labels, TextSecondary72 for secondary content).
3) Accent colors (AuroraCyan, AuroraViolet, AuroraGreen) used sparingly for primary actions and key states.

containers: All screens: fillMaxSize() with horizontal padding 20.dp
Cards: GlassCard with contentPadding of 16.dp (p-4), 20.dp (p-5), or 24.dp (p-6)
Grids: Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp) for gap-4, Arrangement.spacedBy(24.dp) for gap-6
sectionRhythm: Vertical spacing: Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp)) for small gaps, 16.dp for medium, 20-24.dp for large
Horizontal spacing: Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp) for small, 12.dp for medium, 16.dp for large
Card padding: 16.dp (p-4) for compact, 20.dp (p-5) for standard, 24.dp (p-6) for spacious

primaryRadii: RoundedCornerShape(24.dp) - rounded-2xl (glass cards, table shells, sidebar containers)
CircleShape - rounded-full (pills, nav items, status dots, CTAs)
shapeLanguage.borders: Thin white borders at low opacity (StrokeSubtle10, StrokeDefault12, StrokeDefault14, StrokeStrong16)

raised.usage: Elevated surfaces (not currently used but available)

overlay.usage: Overlay surfaces (not currently used but available)

green.usage: Success states, positive trends, status indicators

subtle10.usage: Subtle dividers, table shells, transaction cards (10% opacity)

displaySmall.usage: Dashboard hero headline, major section titles

bodySmall.usage: Small body text, table cells, transaction titles

backdropBlur.note: Backdrop blur is handled by system via GlassCard background. Compose doesn't have direct backdrop blur modifier, but glass effect is achieved through translucent backgrounds.
backdropBlur.implementation: Use GlassFill7, GlassFill6 with appropriate opacity for glass effect

AuroraBackdrop.description: Atmospheric background with gradient and horizon glow

horizonGlow.usage: Horizon glow layer centered at 50% horizontal, 35% vertical

implementation.usage: Render once at screen root level, before Scaffold or main content

GlassCard.description: Primary glass surface component - exact from design-system.json
GlassCard.signature: @Composable fun GlassCard(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, contentPadding: PaddingValues = PaddingValues(20.dp), content: @Composable () -> Unit)

specification.shadow: shadow(elevation = 24.dp, shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), ambientColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.55f), spotColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.55f))

GlassCard.usage: All glass surfaces: sidebar container, stat cards, chart cards, transaction feed, table container

Pill.signature: @Composable fun Pill(text: String, active: Boolean = false, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, textStyle: TextStyle = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, onClick: (() -> Unit)? = null)
Pill.usage: Header navigation pills, time period filters, chart legend items, status badges
Pill.hoverState: Not implemented in current version (Compose handles interaction states differently)

GlassButton.signature: @Composable fun GlassButton(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: ButtonVariant = ButtonVariant.Secondary, onClick: () -> Unit)

StatusDot.signature: @Composable fun StatusDot(color: Color, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: Dp = 8.dp)
StatusDot.usage: Transaction status indicators, navigation active indicators
StatusDot.note: Glow effects are applied via shadow modifier in usage, not in component itself

stats.layout: Column with spacedBy(16.dp), rows chunked by 2

statCard.content: Row with SpaceBetween for label/value, trend badge, delta text
statCard.spacing: Spacer(height = 8.dp) between label and value, Spacer(height = 12.dp) before delta

chartCard.header: Row with SpaceBetween for title/subtitle and legend
chartCard.spacing: Spacer(height = 20.dp) before chart, Spacer(height = 12.dp) before axis

transactionCard.items: Box with RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), GlassFill6 background, StrokeSubtle10 border
transactionCard.spacing: Spacer(height = 20.dp) before items, Spacer(height = 12.dp) between items

table.rows: Box with padding, Row with spacedBy(16.dp)
table.spacing: Spacer(height = 20.dp) before table, Spacer(height = 8.dp) before rows, Spacer(height = 4.dp) between rows

whenAddingNewComponents: Always use Jetpack Compose. Never create XML layouts for UI components.
Wrap all screens with VanishAITheme { ... } to ensure theme consistency.
Use existing components (GlassCard, Pill, GlassButton, StatusDot) unless there's a clear reason not to.
Match existing spacing patterns: 8.dp small, 16.dp medium, 20-24.dp large. Use Spacer or Arrangement.spacedBy().
Define all interaction states (hover via Modifier.clickable, pressed, focused, disabled) using opacity and border changes.
Use MaterialTheme.typography for all text styles. Never hardcode font sizes unless overriding a specific style.
Use color variables from Color.kt. Never hardcode hex values.
Apply glass effect using GlassFill7, GlassFill6 with appropriate opacity and StrokeDefault12 borders.
Use RoundedCornerShape(24.dp) for cards, CircleShape for pills/buttons, RoundedCornerShape(16.dp) for table headers.
Apply shadows using shadow() modifier with elevation 24.dp and Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.55f) for cards.
Render AuroraBackdrop once at screen root level before other content.

colorUsage.backgrounds: Use InkBase for screen background, GlassFill7 for cards, GlassFill6 for secondary surfaces
colorUsage.text: Use TextPrimary for headlines/important text, TextSecondary72 for regular text, TextTertiary52 for labels
colorUsage.borders: Use StrokeDefault12 for cards, StrokeSubtle10 for dividers, StrokeStrong16 for active states
colorUsage.accents: Use AuroraCyan for primary actions, AuroraViolet for secondary/charts, AuroraGreen for success
colorUsage.status: Use StatusDanger for errors, AuroraGreen for success, AuroraCyan for info

typographyUsage.headlines: Use displaySmall (32.sp) for hero headlines, headlineMedium (24.sp) for stat values
typographyUsage.body: Use bodyMedium (16.sp) for standard text, bodySmall (14.sp) for compact text
typographyUsage.labels: Use labelSmall (11.sp) with letterSpacing = 1.sp or 1.2.sp for section labels and table headers
typographyUsage.emphasis: Add FontWeight.SemiBold for card titles, FontWeight.Medium for emphasized table cells

spacingUsage.screenPadding: Always use 20.dp horizontal padding for screen content
spacingUsage.cardPadding: Use 16.dp for compact (sidebar), 20.dp for standard (stat cards), 24.dp for spacious (chart cards)
spacingUsage.verticalSpacing: Use 8.dp for small gaps, 16.dp for medium, 20-24.dp for large sections
spacingUsage.horizontalSpacing: Use Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp) for small, 12.dp for medium, 16.dp for large

antiPatterns: Do not use XML layouts for UI components - use Compose only.
Do not hardcode colors - always use variables from Color.kt.
Do not hardcode font sizes - use MaterialTheme.typography styles.
Do not introduce new component libraries without instruction.
Do not use heavy drop shadows - stick to elevation 24.dp with 0.55 alpha.
Do not use excessive spacing - keep it tight and efficient (max 24.dp for large gaps).
Do not create new glass colors - use existing GlassFill6, GlassFill7 variants.
Do not use different border colors - stick to white with opacity (StrokeDefault12, etc.).
Do not forget to render AuroraBackdrop at screen root for Dashboard screens.
Do not use Material 2 components - use Material 3 only.

accessibility.textContrast: Ensure text meets WCAG contrast requirements (TextPrimary on InkBase meets AAA)
accessibility.touchTargets: Minimum 48.dp touch target size for interactive elements
accessibility.semantics: Use appropriate semantics modifiers for screen readers
accessibility.focusStates: Ensure all interactive elements have visible focus indicators

performance.lazyLists: Use LazyColumn/LazyRow for scrollable lists with many items
performance.recomposition: Avoid unnecessary recomposition by using remember and derivedStateOf
performance.modifiers: Chain modifiers efficiently, avoid creating new modifier instances in recomposition

materialThemeMapping.note: Material 3 theme is configured via VanishAITheme. Components can access theme values via MaterialTheme.colorScheme and MaterialTheme.typography.
materialThemeMapping.typography: All MaterialTheme.typography styles use HelveticaFamily with specified sizes, weights, and letter spacing
